name: RF measurement or new capability
about: Propose evidence with conditions and unresolved interpretations
---

## Hypothesis and minimal experiment

## Setup

- Firmware/host identities:
- Frequency, internal route, BW and nominalFs:
- RX gain index / TX gain setting / source amplitude:
- Antennas or conducted fixture / attenuation / distance:
- Reference on/off and RX retune comparison:

## Final results

State pass/fail/partial and units. Include clipping/RMS, byte losses, stop/drain and finite TX exit. Explain calibration and uncertainty. Non-detection alone does not establish a physical limit.

## Reproduction and retention

Link a small final report; disclose whether original samples are available. Separate software reconstruction from silicon evidence and do not submit uncleared vendor files.
